title: Looking for feedback on a v2 of my game trailer!
author: The_Final_Ideology
selftext: You can see v1 in my post history, rough as a badger's arse to say the least. Using AI to help guide my design decisions for v2, I feel like I'm going in the right direction here but would really appreciate some honesty from other people!

comments.author: Beneficial_Feed_2595
comments.body:
Lol the communists? We’re still worried about the communists in the eyes of our lord 300027 or whenever this is set? 

I wish the game play hook was clearer. Nothing about this is pulling me. I wish the game play hook or what makes it fun was clearer.

replies.author: The_Final_Ideology
replies.body:
It's set around 2000 years from now, it's sort of a literal take on the "what would happen if you gave Capitalism one planet and Communism another, what would they look like in 1000 years" type deal, or my take on that.

I appreciate the feedback! Yeah I suppose I was going for more of a cinematic trailer over gameplay to hook people in since it's a strategy game so not exactly action packed visuals, I was taking inspiration from the cinematic trailers for like HOI4 and stuff, who keep it fairly abstract. Maybe inject some kind of pure gameplay footage in at or near the start?

comments.author: RosesandEternity
comments.body: Gasp not the communists \*clutched pearls\* the socialists too???

replies.author: The_Final_Ideology
replies.body: Next update is going to be to add a customizable policy on each planet forcing citizens to share one communal toothbrush
